Prepare step by step

  1. List current clinicians, medicines and supports privately.
  2. Ask about consent, privacy and who can receive information after transition.
  3. Confirm coverage, records transfer, refills and appointment timing directly.
  4. Build independence gradually while respecting disability, capacity and support needs.

General care navigation and visit preparation only; no diagnosis, treatment, medication instruction, coverage decision or clinical interpretation.
